comment: Connecting two or three systems is used to demonstrate value, but the selection criteria for those systems are not given. Choosing only cooperative or technically mature systems may create an unrepresentative demonstration.

public.text: Connecting two or three systems is used to demonstrate value, but the selection criteria for those systems are not given. Choosing only cooperative or technically mature systems may create an unrepresentative demonstration.
public.suggestedRevision: Select systems based on public value, representative complexity, readiness, dependency coverage, equity, data quality, and scale potential. Document why they are representative of later expansion.
